'''Chandrilans''' were natives of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], a planet located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]], was a Chandrilan.<ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Chandrilans had a low [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] rate, so [[Youngling/Legends|children]] were highly prized.<ref name="Heroes and Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
